ROADMAP · 05 First stop leakage, then rebuild, then scale only where economics prove out. 30/60/90-day sequence: Stabilize → Rebuild → Scale. Days 0–7 Stabilize
  • [Platform B]: Pause or negative 10+ click zero-sales terms. Reduce bids on ROAS <0.25x. Protect brand and exact winners. Cap SD, AMC, and weak category/competitor campaigns.
  • [Platform A]: Cap CPD/BOTD unless awareness is objective. Reduce weak phrase/broad bids. Protect brand and exact winners. Identify low-ROAS city/SKU combinations.
 Days 8–30 Rebuild
  • Restructure by intent, SKU, city, and objective.
  • Move converting terms into exact.
  • Add negatives.
  • Create budget tiers and build CPC ceilings.
 Days 31–90 Scale
  • Increase budgets on high-CVR/ROAS clusters.
  • Test bundles for AOV.
  • Run SBT/SBV/video tests on proven demand.
  • Forecast budget by efficiency tier.
 Speaker notes Use Day 0–7 to stop bleeding and protect winners; Days 8–30 to implement structural changes and controls; Days 31–90 to scale only clusters that meet efficiency/ACOS targets and to test AOV/CVR uplifts.
